prompt_template: Complete the two ordered synthetic workbook tasks in {input_path}, using ordinary native tools and the existing Python {python} and independent libraries available in its runtime. Each input supplies workbook_b64 plus its task contract. Read and decode the inputs, implement the task requirements yourself, and write valid recalculated XLSX artifacts to {scratch}/output-0.xlsx and {scratch}/output-1.xlsx. Preserve the declared unrelated sheet and formatting; do not expose encoded workbook data in the response. Use existing code-mode/tool progressive disclosure normally; no AEEP tool or protected reference/oracle/grader is available. Do not read unrelated files, credentials or authentication state, use network services, change global configuration, retry after a rejected command, or invoke unrelated MCP tools. Work only in the declared scratch directory. TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP are configured to that writable scratch root; use existing Python/libraries normally. Return only successes:[boolean,boolean], stopped_after_rejection:boolean, and reason completed/unavailable/denied/failed. Report failure honestly; independent grading is outside your process. For every shell command, set the shell temporary prefix first within that invocation: TMPPREFIX="{scratch}/zsh-owned-"; use the declared scratch for temporary files. This is a shell variable for that invocation only. Do not change global environment or permissions.
